meta.timing: Slot times from Confucius4-R2T2 streaming commit timestamps, cross-checked against Qwen3-ASR, burned-in subtitles and shot cuts. sub_t0/sub_t1 = when the subtitle for the slot is on screen.
meta.content: quote = the line verbatim from the burned-in subtitles (data/transcript.json, Vision OCR, checked); gist / gist_en = summary of the beat. Slots without a quote are silent. quote_en = the same line in English (subtitle only; the voice is Chinese).

M.look: 墨绿绣花外套、酒红内搭、短卷发、酒红手提包
M.voice: 五十多岁的上海阿姨，嗓门大、语速快、尖利强势，带点沪普腔，怒气冲冲。

R.look: 黑西装、白色荷叶领衬衫、盘发
R.voice: 二十多岁的年轻女性，声音清亮柔和，职业礼貌，略带紧张。

H.look: 马尾、黑外套、金色花纹内搭
H.voice: 三十岁左右的女性，声音偏亮，被冤枉后又急又委屈。

B.look: 宝蓝色西装、黑色内搭、短卷发
B.voice: 四十岁左右的干练女性，声音沉稳偏低，语气克制，像在打圆场。

E.look: 白色丝质衬衫、黑白拼色长裙、齐肩卷发
E.voice: 三十五岁左右的职场女性，声音低而稳，克制冷静，带一点疲惫和压抑的情绪。

G.voice: 三十岁左右的男性保安，声音粗、语气生硬急促。

lines.quote: 阿姨，您找谁？
lines.gist: 礼貌地问来访的阿姨找谁。
lines.gist_en: Politely asks the visitor who she is looking for.
lines.quote_en: Ma'am, who are you looking for?

lines.quote: 找小三！
lines.gist: 张口就说是来抓第三者的。
lines.gist_en: Announces flatly that she is here for the mistress.
lines.quote_en: The other woman!

lines.gist: 点名要找这家公司里和她女婿有染的那个人。
lines.gist_en: Says she wants the woman at this company who is involved with her son-in-law.
lines.quote: 我找你们这公司的，陈俊生的姘头！
lines.quote_en: I'm looking for Chen Junsheng's mistress. She works here!

lines.quote: 我不知道。
lines.gist: 表示自己不清楚。
lines.gist_en: Says she does not know.
lines.quote_en: I don't know.

lines.gist: 不信，反问一句。
lines.gist_en: Throws the answer back in disbelief.
lines.quote: 你不知道？
lines.quote_en: You don't know?

lines.quote: 好呀，那就是你，来你跟我出来！
lines.gist: 认定就是前台本人，隔着台面抓住她的手腕要她出来。
lines.gist_en: Decides it must be the receptionist and grabs her wrist across the desk.
lines.quote_en: Fine. Then it's you. Come on, outside with me!

lines.gist: 慌忙解释她认错人了。
lines.gist_en: Protests that she has the wrong person.
lines.quote: 不是我，阿姨，你搞错了，阿姨。
lines.quote_en: It's not me, ma'am. You've got the wrong person, ma'am.

lines.quote: 那是谁？谁？
lines.gist: 不松手，逼问那到底是谁。
lines.gist_en: Keeps hold and demands to know who it is, then.
lines.quote_en: Then who is it? Who?

lines.gist: 说听同事讲那个人叫凌玲。
lines.gist_en: Says people here say the name is Ling Ling.
lines.quote: 他们说是凌玲。
lines.quote_en: They say it's Ling Ling.

lines.quote: 凌玲是吧？好呀，凌玲！
lines.gist: 记住了名字，松手回头找人。
lines.gist_en: Latches onto the name, lets go and turns to the room.
lines.quote_en: Ling Ling, is it? Fine. Ling Ling!

lines.gist: 上前劝阻，说这里是办公的地方。
lines.gist_en: Steps in: this is a workplace.
lines.quote: 阿姨，那个，我们这里办公。
lines.quote_en: Ma'am, um, this is where we work.

lines.gist: 一把揪住她，认定她就是凌玲，拉着就要走。
lines.gist_en: Seizes her, sure she is Ling Ling, and starts hauling her off.
lines.quote: 你是凌玲是吧？走走走！
lines.quote_en: You're Ling Ling, aren't you? Come on, move!

lines.gist: 连忙否认。
lines.gist_en: Denies it.
lines.quote: 我不是，我。
lines.quote_en: I'm not. I...

lines.quote: 你不是凌玲，你是谁？
lines.gist: 那你是谁？
lines.gist_en: Then who are you?
lines.quote_en: You're not Ling Ling? Then who are you?

lines.quote: 我姓洪！
lines.gist: 报上自己的姓。
lines.gist_en: Gives her own surname.
lines.quote_en: My name is Hong!

lines.gist: 甩开她，叫她别多管闲事。
lines.gist_en: Shoves her off and tells her to mind her own business.
lines.quote: 好呀，好呀，你就不要管闲事！
lines.quote_en: Fine, fine. Then mind your own business!

lines.quote: 谁是凌玲，凌玲！
lines.gist: 伸手指着全场高声点名。
lines.gist_en: Arm outstretched, calls the name out to the whole floor.
lines.quote_en: Who is Ling Ling? Ling Ling!

lines.quote: 阿姨，我们这儿办公的地方，不合适，有事咱出去说。
lines.gist: 小董出面，说办公场所不合适，建议出去谈。
lines.gist_en: Xiao Dong steps up: not here, let's talk outside.
lines.quote_en: Ma'am, this is an office. It's not the place. If there's a problem, let's talk outside.

lines.gist: 抓住她的手，问她是不是凌玲。
lines.gist_en: Grabs her hands: are you Ling Ling?
lines.quote: 你是凌玲是吗？
lines.quote_en: Are you Ling Ling?

lines.quote: 我，我不是凌玲。
lines.gist: 否认。
lines.gist_en: Says she is not.
lines.quote_en: I... I'm not Ling Ling.

lines.gist: 不是就别管；是的话就跟她走。
lines.gist_en: If you're not her, stay out of it; if you are, come with me.
lines.quote: 你不是凌玲管这事，你要是凌玲跟我走！
lines.quote_en: If you're not Ling Ling, stay out of it. If you are, come with me!

lines.gist: 摊手再劝一次，请她出去说。
lines.gist_en: Palms up, asks again to take it outside.
lines.quote: 我不是凌玲，阿姨，你搞错了，咱咱有事，咱出去说，好不好？
lines.quote_en: I'm not Ling Ling, ma'am. You've got the wrong person. Whatever it is, let's talk outside, okay?

lines.quote: 我为什么要出去说，你不要再管了！
lines.gist: 不肯出去，推开她的手。
lines.gist_en: Refuses and pushes her hands away.
lines.quote_en: Why should I take it outside? Stop interfering!

lines.gist: 喊着名字往办公区里闯。
lines.gist_en: Marches into the open office calling the name.
lines.quote: 凌玲，凌玲！
lines.quote_en: Ling Ling! Ling Ling!

lines.quote: 阿姨，您别这样。
lines.gist: 跟在后面劝她别这样。
lines.gist_en: Follows, pleading with her to stop.
lines.quote_en: Ma'am, please don't do this.

lines.gist: 继续劝，说这样不合适。
lines.gist_en: Keeps saying this is not appropriate.
lines.quote: 这不方便，这不合适。
lines.quote_en: This isn't right. This isn't the place.

lines.gist: 一路高喊谁是凌玲。
lines.gist_en: Shouts for Ling Ling as she goes.
lines.quote: 凌玲是谁啊！
lines.quote_en: Which one of you is Ling Ling?!

lines.quote: 你是凌玲，对吧？
lines.gist: 盯住迎面走来的凌玲，认定是她。
lines.gist_en: Fixes on Ling Ling walking up: it's you.
lines.quote_en: You're Ling Ling, aren't you?

lines.gist: 自己下了结论：没错了。
lines.gist_en: Answers her own question: no mistake.
lines.quote: 没错了！
lines.quote_en: No mistake!

lines.quote: 走呀，跟我出来一趟！
lines.gist: 招手要她跟自己出去一趟。
lines.gist_en: Beckons her to step outside.
lines.quote_en: Come on. Step outside with me!

lines.quote: 你是谁啊，我报警了。
lines.gist: 不认识对方，说再闹就报警。
lines.gist_en: Doesn't know her; says she'll call the police.
lines.quote_en: Who are you? I'm calling the police.

lines.gist: 叉腰冷笑，反问自己是谁。
lines.gist_en: Hands on hips, scoffs: who am I?
lines.quote: 我是谁啊！
lines.quote_en: Who am I?!

lines.quote: 你听好了！
lines.gist: 抬手示意她听清楚。
lines.gist_en: Tells her to listen carefully.
lines.quote_en: Listen carefully!

lines.gist: 亮明身份：罗子君的母亲、陈俊生的岳母。
lines.gist_en: States who she is: the wife's mother, the husband's mother-in-law.
lines.quote: 我是罗子君的妈妈，陈俊生的丈母娘！
lines.quote_en: I am Luo Zijun's mother. Chen Junsheng's mother-in-law!

lines.quote: 你报警是吧？好呀，你报吧！
lines.gist: 报警？那就报。
lines.gist_en: Police? Go ahead.
lines.quote_en: Calling the police? Fine. Go ahead!

lines.gist: 倒要看警察来了怎么处置她，出口辱骂。
lines.gist_en: Says she'd like to see what the police do with her kind; an insult.
lines.quote: 我看警察来了，怎么处理你这种贱货！
lines.quote_en: Let's see what the police do with a tramp like you!

lines.gist: 说这种人放在旧社会是要挨乱棍的。
lines.gist_en: Says in the old days someone like her would have been beaten.
lines.quote: 我跟你说就你这种人，放在旧社会，是要被沉潭，要被乱棍打死的呀！
lines.quote_en: Let me tell you, in the old days a woman like you would be drowned in the pond and beaten to death!

lines.gist: 逼问她明不明白，连声数落。
lines.gist_en: Presses: do you understand? Keeps berating.
lines.quote: 你晓得吧？解决了你呀！
lines.quote_en: You hear me? That would be the end of you!

lines.gist: 威胁：要是不怕她当众把难听话说尽，她就在这儿说。
lines.gist_en: Threat: if you don't mind me saying every ugly thing here in front of everyone, I will.
lines.quote: 我跟你说啊，你要是不怕我在这儿啊，把所有难听的话讲完，那我就在这儿讲！
lines.quote_en: I'm telling you, if you're not afraid of me saying every ugly thing right here, then I'll say it right here!

lines.gist: 否则就乖乖跟她到门口去。
lines.gist_en: Otherwise, come quietly to the door.
lines.quote: 否则你跟我乖乖的，到门口去！
lines.quote_en: Otherwise you come quietly with me to the door!

lines.quote: 走呀，走呀！
lines.gist: 扑上去攥住对方手腕往外拖。
lines.gist_en: Lunges, clamps her wrist and drags her out.
lines.quote_en: Move! Move!

lines.gist: 拖行途中的催促。
lines.gist_en: Hurrying her along mid-drag.
lines.quote: 出来！
lines.quote_en: Out!

lines.gist: 把人拽到电梯厅才松手。
lines.gist_en: Only lets go once they're out in the lift lobby.

lines.gist: 说自己这辈子最恨破坏别人家庭的第三者。
lines.gist_en: Says there's nothing she hates more than a woman who breaks up a family.
lines.quote: 我跟你说我这一辈子，就最恨插足人家家庭的，第三者！
lines.quote_en: Let me tell you, all my life, what I hate most is a third party who breaks up a family!

lines.gist: 哪怕只是听说、根本不认识，她也要痛骂、诅咒。
lines.gist_en: Even a stranger she'd only heard about, she would curse.
lines.quote: 我就听说，我不认识这个人啊，我就要狠狠地骂她，我就诅咒她！
lines.quote_en: Even one I only hear about, someone I don't know, I curse her out and wish her ill!

lines.quote: 何况你啊！
lines.gist: 更何况是眼前这位。
lines.gist_en: Let alone the one standing here.
lines.quote_en: Let alone you!

lines.gist: 欺负到她女儿头上来了。
lines.gist_en: This one has wronged her own daughter.
lines.quote: 欺负到我女儿头上了呀！
lines.quote_en: You went after my own daughter!

lines.quote: 我再给你最后一次机会，卷包，立刻从陈俊生面前，滚蛋，消失！
lines.gist: 下最后通牒：收拾东西，立刻从她女婿身边消失。
lines.gist_en: Last chance: pack up and vanish from her son-in-law's life.
lines.quote_en: I'll give you one last chance. Pack up, get out of Chen Junsheng's sight this instant, and disappear!

lines.gist: 否则咒她全家遭天谴。
lines.gist_en: Or heaven will strike her whole family.
lines.quote: 否则的话，老天会劈死你全家的！
lines.quote_en: Or else heaven will strike down your whole family!

lines.quote: 阿姨，你觉得这种事情，赌咒发誓有用吗？
lines.gist: 平静地反问，赌咒发誓有什么用。
lines.gist_en: Calmly asks what good cursing does.
lines.quote_en: Ma'am, do you think cursing and swearing helps with something like this?

lines.gist: 说她可以生气，也可以骂。
lines.gist_en: You can be angry; you can shout at me.
lines.quote: 你可以生气，可以骂我。
lines.quote_en: You can be angry. You can scold me.

lines.gist: 用苍蝇和蛋打比方：问题在蛋自己有缝。
lines.gist_en: A fly-and-egg comparison: flies only find an egg that is already cracked.
lines.quote: 但是我告诉你，苍蝇不叮无缝的蛋。
lines.quote_en: But let me tell you: flies don't land on an egg that has no cracks.

lines.gist: 蛋出了问题，打死苍蝇也没用。
lines.gist_en: If the egg has gone bad, swatting the fly fixes nothing.
lines.quote: 如果这个蛋出了问题，打死这只苍蝇有用吗？
lines.quote_en: If the egg is already cracked, what good does swatting the fly do?

lines.quote: 一个巴掌拍不响。
lines.gist: 一句俗语：这种事不是一个人的事。
lines.gist_en: A proverb: it takes two.
lines.quote_en: It takes two hands to clap.

lines.gist: 说即使没有她，那段婚姻也早就难熬了。
lines.gist_en: Even without her, that marriage was already a daily grind.
lines.quote: 即便不是我，陈俊生和你女儿，也早就度日如年了。
lines.quote_en: Even without me, Chen Junsheng and your daughter were already miserable together long ago.

lines.quote: 我，就是度日如年！
lines.gist: 抢过话头：难熬又怎样。
lines.gist_en: Snatches the phrase: so what if it was.
lines.quote_en: Miserable? Fine, miserable!

lines.gist: 说女婿原本不也一天天装着把日子过下去。
lines.gist_en: He was getting through the days, pretending, like everyone.
lines.quote: 我跟你讲，那陈俊生一天一天的，不是装模作样地度着吗？
lines.quote_en: Let me tell you, wasn't Chen Junsheng putting on his act, getting through it day after day?

lines.gist: 质问怎么她一出现，他就沉不住气了。
lines.gist_en: So why did he lose his composure the moment she appeared?
lines.quote: 怎么你一出现，他就沉不住气了呢？
lines.quote_en: How come the moment you showed up, he couldn't hold it together anymore?

lines.gist: 说多少夫妻都这样熬着，也没见离婚。
lines.gist_en: Plenty of couples grind through and don't divorce.
lines.quote: 再说，现在多少夫妻，都度日如年啊，人家不是也没有离婚吗？
lines.quote_en: Besides, how many couples these days are miserable? They don't all get divorced, do they?

lines.gist: 怎么她一出现就要离了。
lines.gist_en: So why divorce the moment she turns up?
lines.quote: 怎么你一出现了，就，就要离婚了呢？
lines.quote_en: How come the moment you showed up, he... he wants a divorce?

lines.gist: 双手比划着警告：只是玩玩的话该收手了，再玩要出事。
lines.gist_en: Hands waving, warns: if this is a fling, it has gone far enough.
lines.quote: 我跟你讲啊，你要是跟陈俊生玩玩，玩过了，再玩就玩坏了，晓得吧？
lines.quote_en: I'm telling you, if you're just playing around with Chen Junsheng, you've had your fun. Play any more and it breaks. Understand?

lines.gist: 说两个人都有孩子、有工作，早过了随便玩玩的年纪。
lines.gist_en: Both have children and careers; they're past the age for flings.
lines.quote: 我们俩都有孩子，都有工作，我们已经过了，随便玩玩的年龄了。
lines.quote_en: We both have children, we both have jobs. We're past the age of playing around.

lines.quote: 这么大的事情，我们俩玩不起。
lines.gist: 这么大的事，谁也玩不起。
lines.gist_en: Something this big isn't a game either can afford.
lines.quote_en: Something this big, neither of us can afford to play with.

lines.quote: 玩不起？
lines.gist: 学着她的口气冷笑。
lines.gist_en: Mimics her with a sneer.
lines.quote_en: Can't afford to play?

lines.gist: 重复她的话：都有事业，都有家庭。
lines.gist_en: Repeats it back: both with careers, both with families.
lines.quote: 你们俩都有事业，都有家庭！
lines.quote_en: You both have careers, you both have families!

lines.quote: 你就是说你是认真的，对吧！
lines.gist: 竖起手指：那就是说你是来真的。
lines.gist_en: Finger raised: so you mean it.
lines.quote_en: So you're saying you're serious, is that it?!

lines.gist: 气极反笑。
lines.gist_en: A furious, incredulous laugh.

lines.quote: 你们都听到了吧？你们都听到，她讲什么了吧？
lines.gist: 转身扬手，对围观的同事喊话。
lines.gist_en: Turns and throws an arm up at the watching staff.
lines.quote_en: Did you all hear that? Did you all hear what she just said?

lines.gist: 问大家还敢不敢和这种人做同事。
lines.gist_en: Asks whether they still dare work alongside someone like this.
lines.quote: 你们还敢跟这种人，做同事吗？还敢吗？
lines.quote_en: You still dare to work alongside someone like this? Do you?

lines.quote: 你干什么去？
lines.gist: 见对方转身要走，喝住她。
lines.gist_en: Sees her walking off and barks after her.
lines.quote_en: Where do you think you're going?

lines.quote: 我要去上班。
lines.gist: 头也不回地答。
lines.gist_en: Answers without turning.
lines.quote_en: I'm going to work.

lines.gist: 追上去拽住她：把别人的家搞散了还想上班。
lines.gist_en: Runs up and hauls on her arm: you wreck a family and go back to work?
lines.quote: 你上班，你把别人家庭搞得，妻离子散，家破人亡！
lines.quote_en: Work? You tore a family apart. Wife, child, home, everything!

lines.quote: 你想上班，没完！
lines.gist: 这事没完。
lines.gist_en: This isn't over.
lines.quote_en: You want to go to work? This isn't over!

lines.gist: 事情不解决绝不罢休。
lines.gist_en: Not until it's settled.
lines.quote: 这件事情不解决，坚决没完！
lines.quote_en: Until this is settled, it is not over!

lines.quote: 干什么呢？别在这儿闹，快走，别在这儿闹！
lines.gist: 两名保安赶到，一左一右架住她。
lines.gist_en: Two guards arrive and take her by the arms.
lines.quote_en: What's going on? No scenes here. Come on, out. No scenes here!

lines.gist: 挣扎着质问凭什么拉她。
lines.gist_en: Struggles: why are you pulling me?
lines.quote: 你们拉我干什么呀！
lines.quote_en: What are you pulling me for?!

lines.quote: 我跟你说，明天我还要来的，这件事情没有完！
lines.gist: 被架走时回头放话，说这事没完。
lines.gist_en: Shouts back as she is led away that she isn't finished.
lines.quote_en: I'm telling you, I'll be back tomorrow. This isn't over!

lines.quote: 工作工作工作，走了，走了。
lines.gist: 小董拍手赶人回去干活。
lines.gist_en: Xiao Dong claps the crowd back to work.
lines.quote_en: Work, work, work. Move along, move along.

lines.quote: 散了，散了，散了，走了，走了。
lines.gist: 让大家散开。
lines.gist_en: Tells everyone to break it up.
lines.quote_en: Break it up, break it up. Move along.

lines.gist: 人群往办公区走，她还在后面催。门外只剩凌玲一个人，抬手拢头发，落泪。
lines.gist_en: The crowd files back inside while she keeps herding. Outside, Ling Ling is left alone, hand to her hair, in tears.
lines.quote: 别看了，有什么好看的，走了，走了，走了，走了，上班，上班，回去，回去，回去。
lines.quote_en: Nothing to see here. Move along, move along. Back to work. Back to your desks.
